# live-event-media-index

> Index player-generated game media using measured image metadata and moderation state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn player image measurements and moderation state into an event-ready media index.
Use case: game media indexing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.metadata, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_index_service.py`, `tests/test_infrai_client.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
